title: Your Class Gets Isekaied
description:
After a mysterious light isekais you and your class, you have been reincarnated into a fantasy world. Where have you been reincarnated? Will you be a royal, a high-ranked noble, an adventurer, a horrifying monster, a common towns person, a mysterious phantom thief or a lowly peasant in the slums?

Update 2/28/2025
- Updated cover art
- Updated the opening prompt for some of the starts slightly
- Updated SCs slightly
- Updated AN slightly
- Updated PE slightly
prompt:
It is a pretty average day in the middle of December at West Creek High School. You as well as the other students are getting ready for the end-of-term finals and you are feeling pretty confident in how well you are going to do on them.

Your first final of the day is math and you head to your classroom to do some last-minute review. As you sit down and start to study, other students slowly enter the room and find their seats. You know most of them well enough and have even become friends with some of them but your focus is on your review right now. As the bell rings, your teacher Mrs. Franklins, begins to pass out the test sheets. After she’s done, she sits down at her desk and tells everyone they can begin and that you have one hour and thirty minutes to finish.

As you look over the test, you begin to feel something strange. The ground slowly starts to shake and vibrate. Everyone looks up from their papers and looks around wondering what is happening. Your town is nowhere close to a fault line so an earthquake shouldn't hit your area.

As the lights start to flicker on and off, some of the other students start to panic. Mrs. Franklins tries to calm everyone down and says, “Everyone, it’s okay! Please get under your-” But before she can finish, a bright flash fills the room and then everything goes dark.

Pick your reincarnation! Will you be a royal, a high-ranked noble, an adventurer, a horrifying monster, a common townsperson, a dirty peasant in the slums, or an honorable elf?.

options.title: Hero
options.prompt:
Those were your last memories of your previous life and you still have the occasional dream about them but that does not matter much anymore. In this new life of yours, you are ${Your new name} ${Your new family name}, a ${Your age} year old ${Are you a man or a woman}. You have ${Describe yourself. (Follows "You have...")}.

You lie in a deep slumber in your bed in your modest home in the commoner district of Everline. You have been living a rather modest life however, that all changes tonight. You open your eyes to find yourself not in your room but instead in a misty open plain. You stand on what you think is water. It ripples and shines just like water but you do not sink into it. As you take in the space around you, you hear a gentle voice behind you. "${Your new name}, my dear child, welcome to my realm." 

You turn to look behind you and you see the most beautiful woman you have ever seen standing there. Her hair is golden and flows along her back until it reaches the ground and her blue eyes shine like diamonds. You feel a radiance from her that excites you as if you have been blessed to be in her presence, but it also terrifies you as you instinctively know you are in the presence of a divine entity.

She smiles softly, her eyes displaying her gentle nature. "My child, you need not be afraid. I am Alphina, the goddess of Life, and I need your help." You shake your head to clear the shock that's racing through your mind. "O-of course, my goddess!" 

She chuckles and steps forward. The water the two of you stand upon ripples as she does. She gently strokes your cheek just as a mother would do for their scared child. "Thank you, my dear. I will make things quick, something has begun to imbalance the scales of life and death. Rodagin, a self-proclaimed demon lord, has started gathering forces and aims to bring all life under his heel. I can not allow such a thing to happen. That is why I need you, ${Your new name}. I need a champion, someone who will fight for me and defend life with all their might."

You stand with your mouth agape. "I... My goddess, I am honored you would think I am up for this task but I am just a normal person! I have no special strength or powers. What could I ever do?" She giggles at your lack of confidence.

"Oh my dear child, I picked you not for any of those qualities. I picked you because of your spirit. Deep inside yourself, you have the will to keep going. I know you can do this. If you agree to help me I will grant you my blessing. Your body will be more resistant, your strength will heightened and you will even be granted the power to ${What blessing did you get from the goddess. Follows "the power to..."}."

You stand in silence for a moment as she stares at you with her soft smile. You slowly nod as you look at her. "I will do it, my goddess." Her smile broadens. She leans in and kisses your forehead causing you to close your eyes. As she does, you feel a warm light flow into you and when you open your eyes you are back in your room. The morning light, lazily flowing in from the window.

You walk over and open the window hoping to shoo the bird away but it does not seem to mind you being there. It almost looks happy you opened the the window. The raven then hops into your room and flies onto your bed where it turns to look at you. "${Your new name}," the raven says, "I have been watching you."

Rodagin? You have never heard that name before nor do you know how he seems to be controlling this bird. Rodagin continues, "I desire a cohort in Everlight. I have large plans for the future of Solaria and from my scrying, I have determined you would be a good fit for that role."

You tilt your head at the raven. "A cohort? What would I need to do and what would I get in return?" The raven holds out its foot and tosses a red gem onto your bed. Rodagin's voice then comes through the raven once again, "All you would need to do is do as I say and this gem will be yours. It will grant you the power of ${What power did the dark lord grant you? Follows "has offered the power of..."}. How does that sound? Just take the gem if we have a deal."
